name: JE_IT_TP_DECLARATION
description: This table contains the third-party declaration process information that provides electronic reports for submission to the government of Italy. This table also contains declaration protocol information received from the tax authorities for declarations submitted in final mode.

columns.name: DECLARATION_ID
columns.description: Record identifier that is associated with the third-party declaration.

columns.name: VAT_REPORTING_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Tax reporting entity for which the extract is run.

columns.name: DECLARATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of declaration. Possible values are 0 for restricted countries, 1 for San Marino, and 2 for third-party listing.

columns.name: YEAR_OF_DECLARATION
columns.description: Name of the year for which data is extracted.

columns.name: MONTH_OF_DECLARATION
columns.description: Name of the period for which data is extracted.

columns.name: PERIOD_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the declaration period.

columns.name: PERIOD_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the declaration period.

columns.name: TRANSMISSION_TYPE
columns.description: Transmission type of declaration. Possible values are 0  for ordinary, 1 for substitution, and 2 for cancellation.

columns.name: TRANSMISSION_PROTOCOL_NUM
columns.description: External declaration number, such as the transmission protocol number for Italy. Number can be received after the actual declaration is submitted to the tax authority.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_PROTOCOL_NUM
columns.description: External declaration number. For example, the document protocol number for Italy. Number can be received after the actual declaration is submitted to the tax authority.

columns.name: REPORT_MODE
columns.description: Extraction mode of the report. Possible values are D for draft and F for final.

columns.name: LATEST_REC_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the declaration record is the latest record. Possible values are Y for yes and N for no.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.
